english: The sea between PACIFIDLOG and\nSLATEPORT has a fast-running tide.\pIf you decide to SURF, you could end\nup swept away somewhere else.
See, isn't it neat?\nThese houses are on water!\pI was born here!

The SKY PILLAR?\p…Oh, you must mean that tall, tall
tower a little further out.\pIf you asked me, I wouldn't climb it.
It's too scary to get up that high.\pLife at sea level in PACIFIDLOG,
that suits me fine.
PACIFIDLOG TOWN\p“Where the morning sun smiles upon\nthe waters.”
